security_justification.audit_integrity: The change preserves an auditable distinction between a successful empty governance range and an absent range summary, so review evidence cannot silently omit inspected scope.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: No authentication or authorization mechanism, identity input, privilege decision, or authority grant is added or changed by this result-summary repair.
security_justification.authority_provenance: The resolved baseline is derived only from local Git commit resolution; it neither creates authority nor treats a ref spelling or ambient execution context as authorization.
security_justification.concurrency: The checker remains a synchronous, single-process command whose empty-range metadata assignment introduces no concurrent shared state or ordering behavior.
security_justification.confidentiality: The summary contains only repository commit identifiers and numeric counts already available to the checker; it introduces no event, credential, or user-data collection.
security_justification.cryptography: No cryptographic primitive, signature verification, hashing policy, key material, or cryptographic trust assumption changes in this bounded checker path.
security_justification.error_disclosure: The successful empty-range message becomes more explicit without exposing file contents, secrets, or diagnostic details beyond the baseline identifier and zero counts.
security_justification.external_security_integration: The checker remains dependency-free and local; it adds no service call, exporter, collector, SIEM connection, browser telemetry, or external security integration.
security_justification.fail_posture: The untracked null control remains fail-closed while the already-valid semantic-empty range remains successful with explicit evidence, preventing a silent change in failure posture.
security_justification.lifecycle: No lifecycle state machine or activation transition changes; the patch only materializes metadata before an existing return in final and implementation perimeter checks.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: Only the checker context owns the range summary fields, and the proposed direct assignment occurs before return without changing policy, repository history, or user artifacts.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: No personal, client, device, browser, or real-user information is processed, transformed, retained, or added to any repository result.
security_justification.resource_retention: The direct assignments are bounded primitive values within one command invocation and create no cache, queue, file, background process, or retained resource.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: The command has no retry, delivery, queue, or redelivery behavior; reporting zero range counts does not create delivery semantics.
security_justification.trust_boundary: The repair does not widen trusted inputs: commit resolution and the existing local checkout remain the only boundary, while path classification still fails closed for untracked probes.
